review_description: The Sales presentation was honest, open and informative.The installation crew were punctual, very polite and efficient.Yes they did organise the grid connection.They were helpful.
3mths lead timeprice pad to cover contingincys (cert. of compliance $110 & tiled roof kit $200 - would expect to be inclusive)

I found a few company's very helpful and informative and a pleasure to talk to and others gave verbal or general quotes but did not follow up with firm written ones and others didn't respond to queries at all which can be frustrating.
We went with Solar First because they were:a. backed by Bunningsb. price competitivec. good salesperson with good advice
